response: Introducing Saved Views, available today for all customers on paid plans. If you find yourself rebuilding the same filters, sorting, and grouping every time you open a project, Saved Views fixes that. Set up the exact combination of filters, sort order, and columns you rely on, then save it as a named view you can return to in one click. Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, a specific sprint, or work assigned to your team, there's room to keep every configuration ready to go. Views aren't just personal, either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it themselves. This makes it easier to standardize how your team looks at projects and cuts down on repeated setup work across your workspace. Saved Views is rolling out now to every paid plan, with no extra configuration required. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
